scientific_limitations: Boocher 2011 provides the historical sparse-determinantal context but not this later symmetric graph-specialized question.
Uses the published radicality and Cohen-Macaulayness theorem for connected sparse symmetric submaximal-minor ideals.
Proves one complete-bipartite family, not the general two-connected graph conjecture.
Does not compute the nonreduced Jacobian singular scheme or nongeneric local analytic types.
An equivalent result in unidentified literature remains possible.
title: Primality and nodal geometry for complete-bipartite sparse symmetric rank-defect varieties
